exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Ether (ETH) traded at $2,056.67 as of 2026-11-11 11:34:56 UTC, +0.03% over one hour and -1.72% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $2,010.36 to $2,097.37; spot sits at 53% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -11.32% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($2,055.68) is below the 72-hour average ($2,115.68). Spot is 15.53% below the seven-day high of $2,434.86 and 2.30% above the seven-day low of $2,010.36.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 3.42% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 49.7, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $13.7 billion, equal to 5.45% of the $251.34 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 29 ("Fear"), versus 34 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink ETH/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $2,058.36, 72 minutes before the spot quote and +0.08% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The market is anchored near the midpoint of its 24‑hour range (53% of the $2,010.36‑$2,097.37 band) and the spot price ($2,056.67) sits only $1.69 above the Chainlink reference price ($2,058.36) that governs settlement, indicating a stable, bullish equilibrium ready to hold [Ex. A, B, G].  

2. Despite a 7‑day downtrend of –11.32%, realized volatility remains modest at 3.42% per day, and the RSI at 49.7 signals no oversold condition, suggesting that any corrective pressure is limited and that price can consolidate upward from the current level [Ex. C, D].  

3. Liquidity is robust with $13.7 billion traded in 24 hours (5.45% of market cap), while fear dominates the sentiment index at 29, a level historically associated with short‑term price rebounds as risk‑averse participants re‑enter [Ex. E, F].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price is essentially flat over the past hour (+0.03%) yet sits near the midpoint of a narrow 24‑hour range (53% of $2,010.36‑$2,097.37) [Ex. A, B], indicating a lack of directional pressure and a high probability of a short‑term reversal toward the lower bound.  

2. Momentum is neutral (RSI 49.7) while the seven‑day trend is sharply negative (‑11.32%) and the 24‑hour average remains below the 72‑hour average ([Ex. C, D]), showing bearish bias that is likely to manifest in the next 24 hours.  

3. Fear dominates sentiment (CFGI 29) [Ex. F] and liquidity is ample (5.45% of market cap) [Ex. E], providing a supportive environment for price declines without abrupt spikes; the Chainlink feed, our settlement benchmark, is only $1.69 above spot, confirming negligible pricing error ([Ex. G]).  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s “midpoint‑of‑range” claim is hollow: the price sits at 53 % of the 24‑hour band, essentially at the upper half, not the centre, and the range is only $87 wide—far too tight to infer a meaningful reversal ([Ex. B]). Moreover, the Bear’s reliance on a neutral RSI ignores that a 49.7 reading is statistically indistinguishable from 50, offering no bearish edge; the seven‑day decline is already priced in, as the spot is merely 2.30 % above the seven‑day low, suggesting limited downside ([Ex. C]). Hence, the evidence does not support a short‑term bear‑ish move. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s claim of a “bullish equilibrium” rests on the spot sitting near the midpoint of a narrow 24‑hour range [Ex. B]; however, that same range is bounded by a low of $2,010.36, merely $46 below current price, and the price is already 15.53% below the seven‑day high [Ex. C], evidencing significant upside‑side weakness, not stability.  

Second, the Bull leans on “modest volatility” and a neutral RSI to argue limited downside risk [Ex. D]; yet realized volatility of 3.42% per day is above the typical 1‑2% baseline for calm markets, and the RSI of 49.7 is essentially flat, offering no bullish momentum, merely indecision.  

Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds short direction justified

findings.finding: Spot price is down 1.72% over 24 h, showing recent weakness
Seven‑day trend is –11.32% and 24‑h average below 72‑h average, indicating bearish momentum
Fear & Greed Index at 29 signals market fear, historically linked to near‑term declines
Realized volatility at 3.42% exceeds calm‑market baseline, allowing downside moves

ruling.opinion: The exhibits show ETH trading below recent averages, a strong seven‑day downtrend, and a fear‑driven sentiment environment. Neutral RSI offers no bullish catalyst, while elevated volatility permits further drops. Consequently the weight of evidence supports a short practice position for the next 24 hours.
ruling.dissent: The Bull points to the price’s proximity to the 24‑hour range midpoint and modest hourly change, arguing stability; however, broader trend and sentiment indicators outweigh these short‑term neutral signs.
